why: rc14: quest log and spellbook in the modern UI, map label with level range

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc14 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: the modern quest log list and the objective tracker: quest titles (the [level] tag stays) and the 'N/M ... slain' lines are Persian.
New: the spellbook: spell names, 'Rank N' and the tree titles are Persian (follows the spell-name switch and the spellbook title setting).
Fix: the map hover label with a level range ('Wetlands (20-30)') is translated.
Fix: zone names on buttons (the breadcrumb above the map) no longer turn into empty boxes: the font is put back whenever the game changes it.
Spells and talents complete at build 70959 (rc13).

Includes rc7 to rc13.
